GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.comment: Jumped Ok , showed pace to lead 1000m, Headed before the corner and dropped out in Straight # dropped out
GetRaceEntryItemByHorsePaged.commentStewards: When questioned regarding the performance, rider stated that the mare is better suited when ridden with cover and, when a beaten horse, was not tested over the concluding stages. She added that, when placed under pressure, the mare made an abnormal respiratory noise and, in her opinion, may have choked down. A post-race veterinary examination revealed the mare to be slow to recover. Trainer was advised that a warning had been placed on the mare for being uncompetitive.
